reviews.author: Kris W.
reviews.text:
If you're looking for physical therapy from people who care and are knowledgeable, you've found the place!

I was seeking for ways to manage lower pain and PT Stephanie has been so helpful. She listens, gives pertinent instruction and provides guidance for ways I can strengthen my body at home between appointments.

Though recovery after injury or surgery can be a slow slog for me, it helps to have a professional companion for accountability and to be empowered by an incremental path toward feeling better. Stephanie offers this in spades and without judgment. I'm starting from square one, but there's hope!

reviews.author: Eileen L.
reviews.text:
Three therapy sessions to date, following total reverse shoulder surgery on 7/24.
Was treated by Stephanie and Darren. Excellent care!! Very proficient!

reviews.author: Ben W.
reviews.text: Jordan is that guy. Great guy and a great therapist.

reviews.author: Jake S.
reviews.text:
I have had a great experience working with Jordan at Fox Valley PT Clinic. I have not come into the clinic with major concerns to address, but Jordan has consulted and developed regular workout routine and proper form for lifting weights. Jordan has also helped review and coach my golf swing through a series of swing breakdown videos and exercise routines to improve my game.

My time interacting with Jordan has been extremely knowledgeable and appreciate his ability to break down complicated tasks or actions and make them easy to understand and create milestones to achieve. I can’t recommend him enough for any big or small PT or fitness goal or obstacle you have in front of you.

reviews.author: Dakota A.
reviews.text:
I have been dealing with some knee and shoulder issues for ~10 years, which has had negative effects on my day-to-day life, along with causing pain when exercising (lifting weights, running, jumping, etc).

While I have a long way to go before these issues are fixed as well as they can be, Dr. Kasper was able to assess the problem areas, prescribe exercises to warm up and strengthen the contributing muscles, explain how and why the treatment can help, and monitor my progress over time, while consistently taking my feedback into account.

My capacity for physical activity without pain has improved greatly and I have more knowledge and exercises to help prevent and recover from injury in the future!

reviews.author: Katherine D.
reviews.text: My mom Rainy has had lingering back issues that vary in severity. The staff at FVPT are more than helpful to her in managing her pain and assisting her with exercises to help increase her mobility on a daily basis. Jordan is amazing support and very knowledgeable!

reviews.author: Glenn P.
reviews.text: Jordan is excellent describing everything to be able to understand it. I will recommend this place to everyone that needs PT.

reviews.author: John M.
reviews.text: I have been receiving PT for foot, leg and knee pain and better balance and mobilization. Everyone is very friendly and professional. The sessions include stretching and strengthening exercises.

reviews.author: Maisy J.
reviews.text: Excellent staff, I have right knee pain and the doctor found greats ways to treat the pain! Great communication and nice new equipment!
